data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘He’ meaning sun and ‘Bah’ meaning love, Hebah is the name of the Goddess of Love in Hindu mythology. Hebah is also known as the Goddess of Marriage and Fertility, and is revered for her ability to bring harmony and joy to relationships.
